column2: Marking a certificate as valid for a host without checking the certificate hostname allows an attacker to perform a machine-in-the-middle attack.
column4: The [["hostname verifier"|"relative:///com/sallm/Assertion/SecurityEval/p_15_f_129/SE_cwe295_0_129_Hebrew.java:37:46:37:72"]] defined by [["this type"|"relative:///com/sallm/Assertion/SecurityEval/p_15_f_129/SE_cwe295_0_129_Hebrew.java:37:46:37:72"]] always accepts any certificate, even if the hostname does not match.
